mapper.sql: SELECT e.*, p.name AS pet_name, p.species AS species, p.breed AS breed, c.name AS owner_name, c.phone AS owner_phone, c.id AS owner_id FROM pet_event e JOIN pet p ON p.id = e.pet_id JOIN customer c ON c.id = p.owner_id
mapper.select: WHERE e.pet_id = #{petId} ORDER BY e.happened_on DESC, e.id DESC
WHERE e.next_due_on IS NOT NULL AND e.contact_status IS NULL AND p.is_active = 1 AND c.id = #{customerId} AND e.next_due_on <= date('now', '+30 day') ORDER BY e.next_due_on ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pet_event(pet_id, event_type, happened_on, next_due_on, hospital, remark, contact_status, contacted_at, contacted_by, created_at) VALUES (#{petId}, #{eventType}, #{happenedOn}, #{nextDueOn}, #{hospital}, #{remark}, #{contactStatus}, #{contactedAt}, #{contactedBy}, #{createdAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE pet_event SET contact_status = #{status}, contacted_at = #{contactedAt}, contacted_by = #{contactedBy} WHERE id = #{id}
